# Disaster Manager Brief - Bordeaux Fires in France

## Overview

```{r, warning = F, echo = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(lubridate)
library(gganimate)
library(ggforce)
library(ggspatial)
library(maptiles)
library(quadkeyr)
library(prettymapr)
library(patchwork)
```

The Bordeaux fires in France started on Tuesday, July 21st, 2026. [@bbc2026wildfires](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx82rl5g0do) states that these fires in France led to the evacuation of tens of thousands of people and the burning of 10,000 hectares (almost 25,000 acres) as of July 24.

```{r, echo = F, warning=F, message = F}
######------- Data Cleaning Functions --------#######

# Convert possible "\N" values to proper numeric NA values
clean_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(na_if(as.character(x), "\\N")))
}


###### ----- Aggregate CSVs ------ ######

aggregate_csvs <- function(path_parts,
                           output_name = "aggregated.csv",
                           dedupe = TRUE,
                           lat_col = NULL,
                           lon_col = NULL,
                           prefix = "",
                           calculate_county_change = FALSE,
                           county_group_cols = c("county_geoid", "county_name", "county_state", "ds")) {
  
  data_dir <- do.call(here::here, as.list(path_parts))
  
  #cat("Reading from:", data_dir, "\n")
  
  if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
    stop("Directory does not exist: ", data_dir)
  }
  
  csv_files <- list.files(
    path = data_dir,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  if (length(csv_files) == 0) {
    stop("No CSV files found in: ", data_dir)
  }
  
  #cat("Found", length(csv_files), "files\n")
  
  combined_data <- lapply(csv_files, function(f) {
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      mutate(source_file = basename(f))
  }) |>
    bind_rows()
  
  if (dedupe) {
    combined_data <- combined_data |> distinct()
  }
  
  
  # Extract date and time from file names
  combined_data <- combined_data |>
    mutate(
      ds = as.Date(sub(".*_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})_.*", "\\1", source_file)),
      hour = sub(".*_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})_(\\d{4}).*", "\\2", source_file)
    )
  
  return(combined_data)
}


analyze_dataset <- function(df) {
  list(
    missing = df |>
      summarise(across(everything(), ~mean(is.na(.)))),

    numeric_summary = df |>
      summarise(across(where(is.numeric),
                       list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
                       na.rm = TRUE)),

    n_rows = nrow(df),
    n_cols = ncol(df)
  )
}

mp_data_bing <- aggregate_csvs(
  path_parts = c("Movement Between Places During Crisis"),
  output_name = "tk_movement_between_places_bing.csv"
)



###### ------- Facebook Population w/o Aggregation ----#####

fb_data_bing <- aggregate_csvs(
  path_parts = c("Facebook Population During Crisis - Bing Tiles"),
  output_name = "facebook_pop_bing.csv",
  lat_col = "latitude",
  lon_col = "longitude",
  prefix = ""
)
```


```{r, echo = F, warning=F, message = F}
moved <- mp_data_bing |>
  filter(start_longitude != end_longitude,
         start_latitude != end_latitude) |>
  drop_na(n_crisis) |>
  rename(`# Users` = n_crisis)
pts <- rbind(
  data.frame(lon = min(fb_data_bing$longitude), lat = min(fb_data_bing$latitude)),
  data.frame(lon = max(fb_data_bing$longitude), lat = max(fb_data_bing$latitude))
)

pts_sf <- st_as_sf(pts, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Download OpenStreetMap tiles
osm <- get_tiles(
  pts_sf,
  provider = "OpenStreetMap",
  crop = TRUE,
  zoom = 12
)
tiles <- quadkey_df_to_polygon(fb_data_bing)
tiles_3857 <- st_transform(tiles, 3857) |>
  drop_na(n_crisis) |>
  rename(`# Users` = n_crisis)
```

```{r}
french_time <- function(ds, hour){
  df <- data.frame(ds, hour)
  
  df$datetime_cet <- ymd_hm(
    paste(df$ds, df$hour),
    tz = "America/Los_Angeles"
  ) |>
    with_tz("Europe/Paris")
  
  # Format
  df$formatted <- format(
    df$datetime_cet,
    "%B %d, %Y %I%p %Z"
  )
  
  # Remove leading zero from hour and lowercase AM/PM
  df$formatted <- gsub(" 0", " ", df$formatted)
  df$formatted <- gsub("AM", "am", df$formatted)
  df$formatted <- gsub("PM", "pm", df$formatted)
  
  df$formatted
}

movement_plot <- function(plot_ds, plot_hour, plot_title){
  time_moved <- moved |>
    filter(ds == plot_ds, 
           hour == plot_hour)
  ggplot() +
    layer_spatial(osm) +
    geom_link(
      data = time_moved,
      aes(
        x = start_longitude,
        y = start_latitude,
        xend = end_longitude,
        yend = end_latitude,
        color = `# Users`,
        #colour = after_stat(index)
      ),
      alpha = 0.5,
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.03, "npc")),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
     theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
)+ 
    ggtitle(plot_title)
}

population_plot <- function(plot_ds, plot_hour, title = T, plot_title = NULL){
  
  lims <- c(min(tiles_3857$`# Users`,
                na.rm = T),
            max(tiles_3857$`# Users`,
                na.rm = T))
  first_time_pop <- tiles_3857 |>
    filter(ds == plot_ds) |>
    filter(hour == plot_hour)
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    layer_spatial(osm) +
    geom_sf(
      data = first_time_pop,
      aes(fill = `# Users`),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.1,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "red",limits = lims)+
    coord_sf(crs = st_crs(3857),
             expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
)
    
  if (title){
    if (is.null(plot_title)){
      p1 + ggtitle(french_time(plot_ds, plot_hour))
    } else{
      p1 + ggtitle(plot_title)
    }
  } else{
    p1
  }
}
```

## All Times Points

```{r}
french_time <- function(ds, hour){
  df <- data.frame(ds, hour)
  
  df$datetime_cet <- ymd_hm(
    paste(df$ds, df$hour),
    tz = "America/Los_Angeles"
  ) |>
    with_tz("Europe/Paris")
  
  # Format
  df$formatted <- format(
    df$datetime_cet,
    "%b %d, %I%p"
  )
  
  # Remove leading zero from hour and lowercase AM/PM
  df$formatted <- gsub(" 0", " ", df$formatted)
  df$formatted <- gsub("AM", "am", df$formatted)
  df$formatted <- gsub("PM", "pm", df$formatted)
  
  df$formatted
}
```


```{r, output = T, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 10}
plots <- list(plot_spacer())
for (ds in as.character(unique(tiles$ds))){
  for (hour in c("0000", "0800", "1600")){
    p <- population_plot(ds, hour, 
            plot_title = french_time(ds, hour))
    plots <- append(plots, p)
  }
}
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 3)+ plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )
```
